title: ABUSE
subtitle: Crack dot Com, 1996 · 2.00 as Debian 2.0 built it for Linux — X11

needsData.hint: Debian's abuse-lib 2.00 laid out as it installs to /var/lib/games/abuse (art/, levels/, lisp/, addon/, abuse.lsp, light.tbl from the source); sfx/ from abuse-sfx is optional for this build

_why: Public-domain C++ from 1996 compiled whole: 2,916 functions, Debian's X11 port unchanged. The program opens its data by absolute path (ABUSE_PATH=/var/lib/games/abuse) and is started there, hence mount, exactPaths and cwd.
_sound: Silent: the X11 build's sound layer is imlib/port/sgi/sound.c's stub, and -nosound is what Debian's own wrapper passed without a sound card.
